methods.bounded_passing_witness: The recovered evidence build contains only the exact evidence code, tests, owner artifacts, and self-excluded review receipt; final-only code remains absent until the evidence seal.
methods.candidate_workaround: Delete only the three uncommitted Neris final-only files through apply_patch, rebuild evidence from the immutable x1 head, and regenerate final code only after the evidence commit is sealed.
methods.failure_signature: The first evidence build refused three uncommitted closeout and canonical files because they were outside the evidence-stage owner allowlist.
methods.recurrence_guard: Materialize closeout tests, closeout builder, and canonical validator only after the immutable evidence commit exists.
methods.rollback: Keep all generated evidence uncommitted, remove only the premature untracked final files, and preserve the refusal at zero credit.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: Bounded line windows and literal stale-token searches covered the closeout builder, tests, and canonical validator without output truncation.
methods.candidate_workaround: Split consistency review into bounded literal searches and explicit line windows, then attribute each result independently.
methods.failure_signature: A broad read-only closeout consistency search exceeded the available output and context bound, so its truncated result earned no review credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Cap diagnostic output and divide multi-file lifecycle reviews before running them in a constrained context window.
methods.rollback: Retain the broad search at zero credit and do not infer completeness from its truncated output.

methods.bounded_passing_witness: A process-specific read-only probe found no continuing builder, and the recovery invocation completed with an attributable terminal result after regenerating only the declared Neris final candidate.
methods.candidate_workaround: Verify that no matching process remains, retain the ambiguous attempt, incorporate it into final truth, and rerun the mutable builder with an explicitly captured session or terminal result.
methods.failure_signature: The first closeout build projection reached its observation timeout without an attributable exit code or captured output; scoped artifacts existed afterward, but that invocation earns zero execution-success credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Capture the complete command result object when a mutable builder can exceed the direct observation window, then poll only the returned session identifier.
methods.rollback: Do not credit the ambiguous invocation; rebuild before staging so every derived receipt includes the retained failure.
